items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Matt Wilkerson, he run what they call a cavalry over there, trying to think, Bancroft, that was the name of it.

ctx.x: About stuff like stuff stuff like stuff stuff like stuff

Matt Wilkerson, he run what they call a cavalry over there, trying to think, Bancroft, that was the name of it. And that was the only two colored spots they had around here in San Francisco. And all the rest of them were white places. And during that time, why local Sikhs were so strong, they said all the territory belongs to them and it was frightening the proprietors from hiring colored musicians. So that's the only two places you had to work. Whereas I said I used to go in and out waiting for my discharge. I…
Can you remember when Sid LaFrawley was up here too? You said you first played with him down the road. In Los Angeles. No, not Sid in Los Angeles.
